top_module.name: motor_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level compact controller and safety wrapper for external DoMINO Automotive Aero service integration. It owns the cfg_bus register window, request packaging, response validation, timeout supervision, actuator clamp logic, safe fallback controller, and status aggregation. The top module retains the full motor-control request/response, safety, timeout, and actuator-command behavior required by the specification while exposing only compact descriptors and control/status signals.
top_module.functionality: Implements a synthesizable safety wrapper around a compact external service interface. The module accepts configuration through a 64-bit register window, issues compact requests when enabled and idle, waits for compact responses, validates response sequence and freshness, enforces timeout and staleness policy, clamps actuator commands to configured min/max limits, and drives a deterministic safe fallback command on timeout, invalid response, stale response, configuration fault, or persistent downstream not-ready conditions. The module never computes aerodynamics internally and never exposes bulk geometry or physics tensors on top-level pins.
responsibilities: Own the control/status register window and enforce policy-safe writes.
Create compact request descriptors only when enabled and not busy.
Track outstanding sequence numbers and request age.
Validate response sequence, freshness, protocol status, and applicability.
Clamp actuator command output to configured limits before asserting valid.
Enter deterministic safe fallback state on timeout, stale response, invalid response, or configuration fault.
Aggregate status flags for external software visibility.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset, clear all outstanding transaction state, clear request and command valids, clear fault accumulation, initialize safe fallback active, and load deterministic conservative safe actuator command and status defaults. The module shall not emit a non-safe actuator command until a response has been accepted and validated.
behavior_rules: All request and response behavior shall be synchronous to clk.
The controller shall not issue a new request while a previous request is outstanding.
Invalid configuration writes shall set a fault status bit and preserve the previous safe configuration.
act_cmd_data shall always be clamped within configured min/max before act_cmd_valid is asserted.
fault_out shall assert whenever fallback is active, a stale command is rejected, or a protocol/configuration fault occurs.
Top-level interface shall remain compact and implementation-friendly; no raw geometry or tensor expansion is permitted.
Any future payload-memory integration must use the specified sky130 macro only after collateral gate verification.

modules.name: register_file_64b
modules.description: 64-bit cfg_bus register-file and policy gate for enable, soft reset, mode selection, timeout threshold, freshness threshold, actuator clamp limits, sequence seed/control, status control, and safe-fallback configuration. This block decodes compact register-window accesses into explicit semantic configuration/status signals and enforces write legality.
modules.functionality: Decodes compact register accesses into semantically explicit control and safety signals. Supports readback of current configuration and status. Updates configuration only when allowed by policy and only if safety constraints are preserved. Illegal or unsafe writes assert a fault indication while retaining the previous safe configuration.
responsibilities: Implement 64-bit cfg_bus window semantics.
Expose semantic configuration outputs for downstream control blocks.
Reject configuration changes that would violate safety constraints.
Provide readback of current config and status.
Emit write-fault indication on invalid writes.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset the register image to deterministic safe defaults, including enable deasserted, soft_reset deasserted, conservative timeout and freshness thresholds, safe actuator clamp bounds, a conservative safe fallback command, and cleared write-fault state.
behavior_rules: All exposed semantic outputs must be explicit ports and must not be derived implicitly in other modules from raw cfg_bus signals.
Unsafe or malformed writes must not partially update any protected safety field.
Read data shall reflect the current committed register image and status snapshot.
cfg_soft_reset may be a pulse or level according to implementation, but must be synchronously sampled.
No raw geometry or model data may be stored or surfaced by this block.

modules.name: request_fsm
modules.description: Synchronous request issue FSM that forms compact request descriptors when enabled and idle. It carries a sequence identifier, compact geometry handle or descriptor reference, compact flow-condition identifier or descriptor reference, and control flags into req_data. It arbitrates request launch with req_ready and blocks issuance while busy or while fallback is active unless safe-mode command emission is explicitly allowed.
modules.functionality: Creates compact, implementation-friendly request descriptors only when the controller is enabled, not busy, not soft-resetting, and downstream transport is ready. The request descriptor must be compact and may contain only identifiers and flags; no raw geometry or tensor payload may be serialized.
responsibilities: Issue compact request descriptors.
Generate and increment sequence identifiers under control of the outstanding transaction state.
Select compact geometry and flow descriptors rather than raw data.
Assert req_valid only when a new transaction is ready.
Respect downstream req_ready backpressure.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset or soft reset, drive req_valid low, clear request launch intent, and return to an idle request state with deterministic descriptor defaults.
behavior_rules: req_data shall be 64 bits or less and must only encode compact descriptor information.
Request issue shall be inhibited while busy or awaiting response.
The request FSM shall not serialize large payloads or any internal model representation.
If fallback is active, the FSM shall not launch a non-safe request transition.
Control flags shall remain compact and explicitly defined.

modules.name: response_validator
modules.description: Compact response acceptance and validation block. It checks resp_valid payloads for outstanding sequence match, freshness policy, timeout indication, malformed or protocol-violation status, and compact actuator-summary compatibility. It produces validated summary data and reject/fault indications for the fallback controller and clamp path.
modules.functionality: Accepts compact response descriptors and validates them against the outstanding request, elapsed age, freshness policy, and protocol correctness. It does not assume or expose full physics fields, only compact status and actuator-relevant summary information.
responsibilities: Validate response sequence number against the outstanding request.
Check freshness and age against programmable policy.
Reject timeout, malformed, or protocol-violating responses.
Provide compact validated summary information only.
Raise stale and fault indications for supervisory logic.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset all validation outputs low and clear stale/fault indications.
behavior_rules: A mismatched sequence number shall be rejected and flagged stale.
A timeout, malformed status, or protocol violation shall be rejected and flagged fault.
Validated summary outputs shall only reflect accepted compact information.
No raw tensors or full flow-field data may be consumed or emitted.

modules.name: timeout_counter
modules.description: Small synchronous age and timeout tracking counter used to implement staleness guard and response-time policy. It measures elapsed cycles or logical age for the outstanding transaction and asserts timeout status when programmable thresholds are exceeded.
modules.functionality: Tracks elapsed age for the outstanding request and asserts timeout or staleness when programmable thresholds are exceeded. The implementation must remain small, synchronous, and timing-friendly.
responsibilities: Count request age while a transaction is outstanding.
Reset age on accepted response or new request launch.
Assert timeout and stale indications at threshold crossings.
Provide compact age information to the validator and fallback controller.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset age to zero and deassert timeout and stale indications.
behavior_rules: Age tracking shall be synchronous and small counter-based.
Timeout and freshness thresholds shall be programmable and bounded by configuration policy.
Counter logic shall not infer large memories or FIFO structures.

modules.name: clamp_unit
modules.description: Actuator clamp and optional deterministic safe-command shaping block. It clamps validated summary-derived actuator commands to configured minimum and maximum bounds before command issuance. It also computes a safe fallback command when fallback mode is active.
modules.functionality: Derives a compact actuator command from validated response summaries and enforces configured min/max bounds. When fallback is active, it provides a deterministic conservative safe command. No raw physics fields are used.
responsibilities: Convert validated compact summary into compact actuator command.
Clamp actuator command within configured minimum and maximum bounds.
Flag clamp violations when clamping is necessary.
Provide deterministic safe fallback command output.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset outputs to conservative safe defaults and suppress clamp violation until valid input arrives.
behavior_rules: cmd_clamped shall never exceed cfg_act_max and shall never be below cfg_act_min.
safe_cmd shall be deterministic after reset and after any fault entry.
The block shall not implement full physics approximations; only compact summary-to-command mapping is allowed.

modules.name: fallback_controller
modules.description: Safe-fallback controller that asserts deterministic safe operation on timeout, stale response, protocol/configuration fault, or persistent downstream not-ready conditions. It manages fallback-active state, fault escalation, and safe command selection.
modules.functionality: Determines when the controller must enter and remain in deterministic fallback. It asserts fault status, requests safe-command selection, and allows a safe actuator command to be issued even under fault conditions when required by policy.
responsibilities: Enter fallback on timeout, stale rejection, protocol fault, or write-fault conditions.
Provide deterministic safe-command selection gating.
Assert fault output whenever fallback is active or a fault condition is present.
Allow safe-command issuance according to policy under fallback state.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset into safe fallback active state with fault asserted or ready to assert according to implementation policy, and deterministic safe-command selection enabled for conservative operation.
behavior_rules: Fallback shall be deterministic after reset and after any fault entry.
fault_out shall assert whenever fallback is active, stale command is rejected, or a protocol/configuration fault occurs.
The safe fallback command path may bypass normal non-safe command issuance only for deterministic conservative output.
Persistent downstream not-ready conditions shall be treated as a policy fault if they exceed configured limits in the top-level supervision path.

modules.name: status_aggregator
modules.description: Aggregates configuration, timeout, validation, clamp, fallback, and transaction state into compact status flags and register readback data. It produces software-visible status summaries without exposing raw payloads or internal bulk data.
modules.functionality: Builds compact software-visible status and register readback views from configuration and supervisory state. It does not expose geometry, flow fields, or model tensors. It provides register readback data for cfg_bus and compact status flags for external firmware.
responsibilities: Aggregate current enable, mode, timeout, freshness, clamp, sequence, age, and fault state.
Provide compact status flags for readback.
Format cfg_bus_rdata readback words for the register window.
Keep all outputs compact and implementation-friendly.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset status outputs to deterministic safe values and mirror safe configuration defaults in readback formatting.
behavior_rules: Status aggregation shall be purely compact and register-oriented.
No raw payload or tensor data shall be emitted.
The block shall only summarize supervisory state and configuration values.
cfg_bus readback shall be consistent with the committed configuration image.
